tagline: 佳能数码单反相机，2016 年发布
description: 佳能于2016年推出的数码单反相机。配备Interchangeable。快门速度Electronic focal-plane。

specs.取景器: Eye-level pentaprism with 100% coverage and 0.71× magnification / LCD (Live View)
specs.存储: Dual slots: CompactFlash (CF) card Type I (UDMA-7 supported) and SD/SDHC/SDXC card (UHS-I compatible)
specs.曝光测光: Full aperture TTL, 252 zones with 150,000-pixel RGB+IR sensor and EOS Integrated Subject Analysis (iSA)
specs.屏幕: 3.2″ (8.1 cm) Clear View II colour TFT LCD touchscreen with 1,620,000 dots
specs.电池: Li-Ion LP-E6N with 900 shots when fully charged
